papers_read.title: MoleculeNet: A Benchmark for Molecular Machine Learning
task_relevance: Confirms BACE, BBBP, ClinTox, HIV, and MUV as standard molecular benchmarks
Supports using dataset-specific metrics and cautions about class imbalance and data scarcity

papers_read.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
task_relevance: Provides canonical graph convolution/message-passing baseline structure
Supports efficiency framing for simple linear-in-edges propagation

papers_read.title: Graph Attention Networks
task_relevance: Highlights neighborhood weighting as a possible alternative baseline family
Reinforces graph neural networks operating directly on structured inputs

papers_read.title: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for an Accurate and Interpretable Prediction of Material Properties
task_relevance: Supports graph representations with edge features and interpretable local contributions
Motivates atom-level contribution analysis for interpretability

benchmark_protocol: Use MoleculeNet-style datasets with dataset-aware metrics
Pay attention to heavy imbalance, especially in MUV; report PR-AUC in addition to ROC-AUC where useful
